description: ai_readme — Generate a README.md for a project from a plain description: title, summary, features, installation, usage with a code example, configuration, contributing, license (style=minimal for a short one). Optional name=, language=, install=, usage=, license=, repo=. Unknown details become TODO placeholders instead of invented commands; returns the Markdown plus section checks, missing sections and any URLs not in your input. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).

description.description: A command-line tool written in Go that watches a folder and uploads new photos to an S3 bucket, with resize and dedupe options.

name: ai_readme
